{{Quote|There are twenty-five thousand apartments in Zorp House. I can't know who lives in them all.|Building manager|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
The '''building manager''' of the [[Zorp House]] apartment tower of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who assisted the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|security force]] and members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] during the investigation into the activities of [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]].
